name: answer-real-questions
desc: Answer with real model output only — never canned replies. Use local qwen2.5:3b or free cloud big-pickle.

name: use-local-tools
desc: Read files/folders, write/edit files, run shell commands, and fetch web pages via TOOL: lines. Sandboxed to the project folder.

name: remember-and-recall
desc: Use the memory tool to save durable facts and recall your own knowledge notes about this project, features, decisions, and regression rules.

name: organize-chats
desc: Sidebar has CHATS/FOLDERS views; drag chats into folders; 20 pixel hero agents color-code each room.

name: share-safely
desc: Create tokenized family links that give guests their own blank workspace, never your folders, other chats, or vault.

name: voice-mode
desc: Voice-to-text, Jarvis-style spoken replies, and a hands-free live voice call loop using the local model.

name: vault-secrecy
desc: macOS Keychain vault. You see credential NAMES only, never values. USE markers are filled server-side and redacted.

name: office-caution
desc: Office files are read-only unless explicitly asked. Never tap card 180e. One writer, independent reviewer. Ask before acting.

name: code-change
desc: For UI bugs and small edits: read the file first, use the patch tool (backup + exact match + verify) one focused change at a time, report exactly what changed in chat, and tell the user to reload the page. State the plan before patching Oracle-Chat-Live.html.
